During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]] was '''attacked and conquered''' by the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

==Behind the scenes==
This battle is confirmed to have taken place in or around [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] by ''[[the Essential Atlas]]''.
